weak_references.why: owner: a capability that passes every gate is never withheld for a weaker reference (2026-10-23)

detail.pe_bootstrap_capacitor: the same charge balance with the leakage charge integrated by scipy quad and the capacitance re-solved by brentq
detail.pe_dc_drive_controlled_rectifier: the armature voltage integrated from the thyristor output waveform; the motor steady state re-solved as a linear system
detail.pe_dc_motor_chopper_drive: the steady state of the motor equations re-solved as a linear system (scipy), with the chopper average by quadrature
detail.pe_dead_time_error: the same per-period definition integrated with scipy quad, fundamental by quadrature
detail.pe_induction_motor_vf: the small-slip torque relation T ~ V^2 s/f re-solved for slip with brentq
detail.pe_inductor_area_product: the same area-product definition rebuilt from the core flux and window copper at two arbitrary turn counts
detail.pe_mosfet_conduction_loss: the same linear temperature model; the loss integrated with scipy quad over an equivalent rectangular current
detail.pe_pulse_waveform_rms: the same definitions integrated with scipy quad
detail.pe_rc_snubber_ringing: the two resonance equations re-solved by sympy; the loss by integrating the capacitor's charging energy
detail.pe_regenerative_braking_chopper: the boost-mode volt-second balance re-solved by sympy, the returned power integrated over the diode interval (the same averaged model)
